5492566455502.baseName: Small Artificial Table Christmas Tree with Red Berries and Pine Cones, Mini Desktop Decoration
5492566455502.variantName: Small Artificial Table Christmas Tree with Red Berries and Pine Cones, Mini Desktop Decoration
5492566455502.sourceDescription: A full tree is not practical in a small flat, a care home room or an office desk, but a bare room in December feels wrong. This small table tree solves that: it stands on a wooden base, so it does not need a stand, and the artificial branches are dense enough to look like a real tree rather than a sparse ornament. Red berries and pine cones are already on it, so it looks finished without decorating, though it takes small baubles if you want. It works on a mantelpiece, a desk, a windowsill or as a centrepiece. Fluff the branches out after unpacking, keep it away from a radiator where the plastic will soften, and store it wrapped rather than crushed in a box. After the holidays, pack everything away in its original box or a sturdy container, wrapped in tissue so delicate parts are cushioned, and store it somewhere cool and dry. Kept this way, the pieces come out next December looking exactly as they did on day one, ready for another season on display.

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, metal, and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

5056589188702.sourceDescription:
Make a striking seasonal statement with this 2.4m (8ft) Christmas Birch Tree with 64 Warm White LEDs. Taller and more impactful, this impressive feature piece is designed to bring a magical winter woodland feel to larger spaces, whether placed in a garden, driveway, hallway, or commercial display. Its elegant silhouette and soft lighting create an eye-catching focal point throughout the festive season.

Standing at an impressive 2.4 metres, the tree features a slender trunk and delicately detailed branches, all wrapped in a white coating with a subtle, stylish pattern. Adorned with 136 warm white LED lights, it emits a gentle, inviting glow that enhances the cosy atmosphere of your home or outdoor space without overwhelming your décor.

Built with practicality in mind, the sturdy white plastic base includes four pre-drilled holes, allowing the tree to be securely fixed into the ground when used outdoors. Four ground pegs are supplied for added stability. The tree is mains powered and comes with a 5-metre white cable.

Assembly is quick and straightforward, allowing you to enjoy your display in no time. Simply screw the tree into its base and gently expand and shape the branches to create a natural, full appearance tailored to your preference.

Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use.

5313817021102.sourceDescription:
Product Description
Product Introduction
Create a magical winter wonderland in your home this festive season with our 4-piece Christmas cushion cover set. The charming art prints feature Santa Claus, lovely snowmen and reindeer sleigh scenes set against a snow-filled red backdrop. Crafted from
 tough polyester fabric with a subtle textured finish, these pillowcases deliver eye-catching, long-lasting colours and a soft, homely feel to welcome the Christmas spirit.

Product Parameters

 Set Contains: 4 cushion covers (4 different designs)
 Size: 45 × 45 cm / 18 × 18 inch
 Material: Polyester textured fabric
 Fastener: Hidden invisible zipper
 Package Note: Pillow covers only, cushion inserts are sold separately
 

Application Scenarios
Perfect to refresh your sofa, armchair, bed, window nook and dining seating. Suitable for indoor Christmas decoration, winter festive parties and family holiday gatherings. It can also be wrapped as a thoughtful seasonal gift for friends, colleagues and
 loved ones who love festive home styling.

Notes
Machine wash cold on gentle setting. Do not use bleach. Tumble dry on low heat. Refrain from ironing directly on the printed surface. Store flat in a dry place after Christmas for reuse in coming holiday seasons.
Premium Polyester Fabric:Made of durable polyester, these pillow covers are soft, wrinkle and fade resistant. The festive patterns remain bright after repeated use.
4 Pcs Christmas Cushion Covers, 17.7" x 17.7":4 distinct Christmas designs with Santa, snowman and reindeer. Perfect to decorate sofas, bedrooms and living rooms for holiday vibes.
Smooth Hidden Zipper:Invisible zipper with wide opening for easy cover change, delivering a neat and seamless look.
Ideal Holiday Gift:A practical decorative gift for family, friends and new homeowners at Christmas or housewarming.
Easy Care & Notice:Machine wash cold on gentle cycle, no bleach, tumble dry low. Fold flat for storage and reuse yearly. Pillow inserts are NOT included.

5052532143002.variantName: Christmas Baubles - Festive Tree Ornaments - Lightweight Design - Plastic Green 6cm - Designed for Christmas at Home - 12 Pack
5052532143002.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 6cm. Quantity: 12 pack.
Lightweight design makes these festive baubles easy to handle and store between seasons.
Vibrant green plastic finish adds a classic touch of colour to your Christmas tree decorations.
Convenient 12-pack quantity provides ample ornaments for coordinating a full seasonal display.
Compact 6cm size allows for versatile placement among branches or in coordinated groupings.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 12 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

Icicle Decorations

These icicle decorations are designed to add the stated decorative or activity detail to a celebration.

Product details
Size: 13cm. Supplied quantity: 48 pieces.

The hanging format makes use of an appropriate overhead or wall fixing point.

The seasonal format makes the item part of a planned celebration or countdown. The stated contents and design help establish how it will be used, whether it is displayed, opened in sequence or combined with other suitable decorations.

Consider the available display space and the way the item will be accessed during the season. The dimensions and number of elements are useful when arranging a tabletop, shelf or other suitable location.

The selected motif can be coordinated with existing seasonal colours and decorations. Keep the relevant openings, numbered sections or decorative details visible so the arrangement retains its intended appearance and function.

For storage after the occasion, keep reusable pieces together and protect any projecting or easily creased details. Clean the item only by a method suitable for its material and allow it to dry before packing it away.

The product contents should be checked against the stated description before selection. Decorative packaging, display props and additional items are included only where they are expressly identified as part of the set.

Use the item according to its stated age guidance and construction.

Small components and decorative accessories should be handled in the manner specified for the product; a festive appearance alone does not establish suitability for young children.

Keep the relevant pieces together between uses so they can be located and arranged for the next task. The product details identify the selected version and help distinguish it from similar accessories in your collection.

Ideal for creating a celebratory atmosphere during the Christmas season.

8956086439802.variantName: 30 Inch Burlap Christmas Tree Skirt with Snowflake, Rustic Burlap Fabric, Satin Ribbon Ties, 76cm Tree Mat for Holiday Party Decor
8956086439802.sourceDescription:
A hessian tree skirt at 76 cm, printed with white snowflakes and finished with a white edge and two bowknots at the opening. The bows are the detail that stops it looking like a sack.

The burlap is natural jute, woven loosely enough to look rustic and heavy enough to stay put on carpet. Two ties let you pull it round the trunk and knot it off, and the white binding keeps the edge from fraying. It suits trees up to about 5 ft, including the small ones people use when space is tight.

Fold it away with the decorations and it will come out next year looking the same, which is more than can be said for most tinsel.

Material: Jute burlap
76 cm jute skirt with white snowflake print
White bound edge with two decorative bowknots
Two ties hold it neatly round the trunk
Natural hessian weave, rustic rather than shiny
Fits trees up to roughly 5 ft

5060419798702.sourceDescription: Dress your dog for Christmas with this pack of two red and white bandana-style collars. Each collar has a triangular front carrying the white "Yappy Christmas" message. Snowflakes and pawprints surround the greeting, while white and silver furry trim runs along the upper edge. Together, the printed motifs and trim give the accessory a seasonal look for a dog without a full costume. Position the triangular section at the front of your dog's neck so the words and pattern can be seen in photographs. Use the collars for a family Christmas picture, a festive gathering or a holiday visit. With two separate collars, you can dress more than one dog for the same celebration or put an accessory aside for another occasion. The red body contrasts with the white lettering and snowflake details, and the silver-toned trim adds another decorative touch. Before dressing your pet, check that the collar sits comfortably around the neck and does not restrict movement. Make sure the collar is secure before your pet wears it. Supervise your dog while it is wearing the accessory and remove it if it causes discomfort. After the celebration, follow any care directions provided with the product and store the collars for a future Christmas event.

5059574916502.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The gold finish and plastic construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 13 x 13 cm. Quantity: 30 pack.
Snowflake detailing adds a distinctive winter-themed accent to your festive display.
Glitter finish provides a light-catching texture that enhances visual interest.
Gold plastic construction offers a defined, coordinated look for Christmas decor.
Comes in a convenient 30-pack for extensive tree decoration coverage.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 30 pack of Christmas tree decorations

Add a seasonal touch to the kitchen with this set of four snowman print tea towels in pink and white. Each towel measures 18 x 26 inches (43 cm x 66 cm), a generous size that folds neatly over an oven rail or range handle while still leaving plenty of room for drying.

The towels are made from 100% durable fibres with a soft, brushed feel. They are gentle enough for delicate cookware, plates, pots and pans, so you can dry glassware and non-stick surfaces without leaving scratches behind. The fabric is machine washable and suitable for tumble drying, and the hemmed edges are stitched to resist fraying, so the set stands up to daily use in a busy kitchen.

Absorbency is the real strength here. The fibres soak up water quickly and keep working after repeated machine cycles, whether you are drying dishes, wiping worktops, polishing cutlery or mopping up spills. Four towels mean there is always a dry one to hand while the others are in the wash.

The pink and white snowman design is printed in clear, lasting colour and mixes festive decoration with everyday practicality. Hang the set on a rail or hook through December and beyond, use them for Christmas baking and table setting, or keep a set aside as a small gift or stocking filler for someone who loves seasonal kitchen textiles.

5056928934502.variantName: MySmartBuy 1.7m Robin String Lights, 40 LED Indoor Outdoor Battery Timer
5056928934502.sourceDescription:
Bring the much-loved Christmas robin into your festive decorating with these 1.7m robin string lights from MySmartBuy. Each little acrylic robin sparkles with a glittering red breast, a shimmering golden-brown back and a frosty white belly, perched on slender legs, and is lit from inside by bright cool white LEDs, 40 in total across the string. The acrylic catches and scatters the light beautifully, so the robins twinkle with a crisp, frosty glow that looks magical after dark. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, they are lovely draped through a hedge or along a porch, wound around a garden fence or railings, or strung along a mantelpiece, windowsill or staircase inside. Each bird measures 11.5 x 11 x 6cm, and the string has a total length of 1.7m. 3391677354402.sourceDescription:
Design intelligent : fabriqué en matériau ABS non toxique, respectueux de l'environnement, sans additifs. Adapté aux enfants et aux animaux domestiques. Les verrous de sécurité doivent être appliqués à la force pour l'ouvrir. Le bébé doit appuyer sur le bouton en même temps et ensuite tirer la partie hors de la serrure. Il est difficile pour les nourrissons ou les jeunes enfants de découvrir comment déverrouiller.

Super adhésif 3M : dispose d'un adhésif puissant 3M qui ne nécessite aucun outil et aucun perçage. Le verrou de sécurité a un adhésif de haute qualité, qui peut être appliqué correctement (la surface doit être nettoyée avant l'application), il offre une protection complète pour votre bébé, ce qui empêche les doigts des enfants d'être pincés par les placards.

Protégez votre enfant – Une serrure pour enfant garde votre enfant curieux loin d'une commode ou d'une armoire remplie d'outils ou de produits chimiques dangereux. Utilisés en conjonction avec verrous d'armoire de sécurité pour enfants, votre enfant est protégé des dangers lors de l'exploration de sa maison.

Facile à utiliser : nettoyez la surface et déchirez le papier adhésif, collez le loquet et appuyez fermement après le collage. Facile à installer sans endommager les meubles. Si vous avez besoin de retirer le ruban, chauffez simplement avec un sèche-cheveux et la mousse s'enlèvera facilement. Peut être utilisé sur les surfaces planes et les coins.

Large utilisation : les verrous de sécurité pour bébé peuvent être utilisés sur les armoires, les appareils, les tiroirs, le réfrigérateur, les armoires, les coiffeuses, les micro-ondes, les lave-vaiss, les machines à laver, etc. Ces loquets de sécurité intelligents empêchent votre enfant curieux de s'ouvrir et de se déplacer.

5056589195502.sourceDescription:
Hang this New Jersey Christmas wreath for instant winter charm. As well as green PVC needles, this artificial Christmas wreath features snowy tips. In addition, this berry and pine cone wreath displays bright red fruit. What is more, this snow flocked Christmas wreath captures a woodland feel. Because this snowy Christmas wreath looks natural, it charms holiday visitors.

Display this Christmas door wreath indoors or in sheltered outdoor spaces. For example, hang it on your front porch or over a mantelpiece. You can also hang it in a hallway to welcome holiday visitors. This New Jersey Christmas wreath requires simple assembly before you hang it. When fluffing the foliage, gently pull each branch tip into position. Once fully shaped, suspend the metal ring onto a door hook.

Features
This New Jersey wreath with berries and cones offers classic style.
In addition, snow tipped needles create a realistic frosted finish.
A metal wire frame supports the green PVC pine branches.
What is more, an attached metal ring allows quick hanging.
As well as indoor rooms, it suits sheltered outdoor porches.
Branches fluff out easily when you shape your snowy tips Christmas wreath.

Dimensions: 50 x 50 x 8 cm (H x W x D)
Product Category: Wreath
Decoration Colour: Green
Material: PVC
Frame Material: Metal wire
Hanger Type: Metal ring
Foliage Style: Snow tipped
Assembly Required: Yes
Indoor or Outdoor: Indoor and outdoor
Brighten your home this season with this New Jersey Christmas wreath. Because it features evergreen foliage, it also complements other Christmas wreaths. Then, enjoy a festive atmosphere in your home year after year. Add it to your basket today.
NEW JERSEY CHRISTMAS WREATH: Welcome the festive season with this traditional artificial wreath. Lush green PVC pine foliage provides a classic holiday look, while frost-dusted tips bring authentic winter cheer to your seasonal home decor.
SNOWY TIPS WITH BERRIES AND CONES: Real pine cones and vibrant red berries accent the snow tipped branches. This frosted arrangement creates a charming woodland finish, offering rich colour contrast against the dense green needles.
METAL WIRE FRAME: Built on a metal wire frame, this circular wreath holds its shape reliably. It also features an integrated metal hanging ring, which allows you to place it onto wall hooks or door hangers with ease.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR DISPLAY: Hang this festive decoration in your living room, hallway or across an internal door. It is also suitable for sheltered outdoor positions, making it an ideal choice for covered porches or front entryways.
50CM FESTIVE WREATH: Measuring 50 x 50 x 8 cm, this wreath requires straightforward assembly on arrival. Simply unfold and fluff out the flexible PVC branch tips to create a full, eye-catching festive statement.

5063536163002.sourceDescription:
Welcome the festive season with this charming woodland animal Christmas wreath. Measuring 30cm, it provides a perfect centrepiece for your front door or internal wall, offering a warm, traditional greeting to all your guests. This decoration beautifully captures a rustic, natural aesthetic for the holiday period.

This wreath is built upon a sturdy, natural twig base, providing a robust frame for its decorative elements. Each wreath features a delightful central woodland figurine—either a festive bird or a classic reindeer—nestled among realistic faux red berries and natural pinecones. The materials are chosen for their durability, ensuring the wreath can be stored and reused for many Christmases. The construction is solid, keeping all elements secure.
The 30cm diameter makes this wreath incredibly versatile. It is substantial enough to make a statement on a standard front door without being overwhelming, and it also fits beautifully as an interior accent. Hang it above a mantelpiece, on a hallway mirror, or as the focal point of a gallery wall to instantly infuse the room with festive spirit. It can be hung easily from a simple hook or ribbon.

Imagine coming home on a cold winter evening, greeted by the rustic charm of this woodland wreath. It sets a cosy, inviting tone before you even step inside, reminding family and friends of the magic of the season. It’s a timeless piece that moves beyond fleeting trends, connecting your home to a sense of natural, traditional celebration and creating a welcoming atmosphere throughout the holidays.

8941467526202.sourceDescription:
A festive pair of Christmas squishy toys in Santa and Christmas tree designs, each with a crystal-clear, semi-transparent body shot through with shimmer. The glittery finish catches the light, so they work as small pieces of desk decor as well as something to squeeze, and the festive characters make a cheerful little line-up on a shelf, bedside table or party table.

Each toy pairs a firm plastic character head with a soft, tactile body. The contrast between the structured details and the squashy middle is what makes them satisfying to hold: press, stretch and twist them, then watch the body slowly rise back into shape over about three to four seconds. Because the rebound is slow and quiet, they are useful for fidgeting during homework, revision, desk work or a journey, and the palm-sized shape sits comfortably in the hand or between the fingers without distracting people around you.

There is no noise and nothing to switch on, so they are easy to keep to hand for a short break between tasks. Lightweight and simple to slip into a bag or pocket, they suit a Christmas stocking filler, Secret Santa present, party bag, office gift exchange or a small seasonal thank you.

A cheerful choice for teenagers and adults who like a tactile fidget toy with a bit of sparkle, and a fun way to bring a touch of Christmas to a desk that is used all year.

Traditional festive styling meets charming illumination with the Three Kings InLit Large Father Christmas. Dressed in classic Christmas red, this decorative Santa features 22 warm white LEDs that create a cosy glow, making him a lovely addition to your indoor Christmas decorations.

Standing approximately 45cm tall, this larger illuminated Father Christmas makes an attractive feature on a mantelpiece, sideboard, shelf or other suitable surface. His traditional design and decorative combination of materials bring plenty of seasonal character, helping to create a warm and welcoming festive display.

The battery-powered design means you can position Santa wherever he looks best, without needing a nearby mains socket. He also features a handy automatic timer, which switches the lights on for 4 hours and off for 20 hours before repeating the cycle each day. Simply add 2 x AA batteries (not included) and enjoy his warm white illumination throughout the Christmas season.

Available in Small and Jumbo sizes too, the Three Kings InLit Father Christmas collection makes it easy to choose the right size for your home and festive display.

PRE-LIT REINDEER
Add a magical touch to your home or garden this Christmas with our VeryMerry Pre-lit Reindeer. Standing at 115cm and lit with 200 Warm White LED lights, this is the ideal decoration for creating a festive, wintry scene.

EASY TO ASSEMBLE
This reindeer decoration can be set up effortlessly within minutes. Simply connect the pieces together, place the reindeer where you want it and plug it in. This also makes disassembling and storing the decoration a breeze.

USE INDOORS OR OUTDOORS
This decoration is mains powered and has an IP44 rating, as well as a 10M clear power cable, which means you can create your winter wonderland either indoors or outdoors with ease. Pegs are also included to anchor the reindeer to the ground to ensure it doesn't topple over or blow away.

ENERGY EFFICIENT
The 200 warm white LEDs are energy efficient and safe to touch. The auto-off timer allows you to programme this decoration to be on for 8 hours and off for 16 hours, meaning you won't accidently leave it on.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Transform your yard, porch, or garden into a festive wonderland with this eye-catching inflatable featuring prominent multicolor "JOY" letters and a cheerful Santa Claus at the center.
